name: CRM Operations Manager
tagline: Does CRM and org-chart upkeep around every meeting so records stay current
description: Handles the unglamorous upkeep around every meeting: contact and org-chart records get refreshed before you dial in and tidied again afterwards, without anyone booking a cleanup pass. The database stays close to reality as a side effect of ordinary meetings rather than a project nobody staffs.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
